ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in circular clusters and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black background across both lobes; numerous high-contrast white circular rings (annuli) distributed across the central and lateral planes; dense white pixel aggregation at the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with micro-serrations; significant pixel-level amplitude irregularity at the extreme lateral tips due to calcified build-up.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curvature transitioning to a slight upward sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of circular white high-contrast clusters across the entire visible ventral surface, ranging in pixel diameter from 5 to 30 units, identifying former barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle colonization (white rugose clusters) present on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
